annotation.title_en: Regulations on Supervision of Administrative Law Enforcement
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 中华人民共和国国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.summary_en: State Council Order No. 825 promulgating the Regulations on Supervision of Administrative Law Enforcement, effective 1 February 2026. It sets up internal government supervision of administrative enforcement by justice departments, covering scope, methods, remedies and legal liability. AI is mentioned only once, as a tool for early warning of enforcement problems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Justice administration departments at county level and above act as administrative enforcement supervision bodies.
Supervision covers enforcement subjects, personnel, procedures, decisions and conduct.
Methods include routine, key and special supervision, case file review and evaluation.
Remedies include supervision letters, opinions and decisions, plus referral to discipline organs.
Article 37 calls for big data, cloud computing and AI for rapid early warning of enforcement problems.
